title: SeinePINN_1D: a hybrid LSTM physics-informed neural network for 1-D tidal-river hydrodynamics
description: SeinePINN_1D reconstructs water level, velocity and discharge along a whole tidal river from its boundary forcing alone (upstream discharge, downstream stage and tributaries). It couples an LSTM encoder of the forcing with a harmonic tidal branch, a hard downstream boundary condition and non-dimensional Saint-Venant residuals. The release contains the Python package, the case files of the Seine estuary (France, 137.7 km, 2007-2025) and of a synthetic estuary with a known solution, the scripts for training, validation, testing and prediction, the generator of the synthetic case, the tool that cuts cross sections from a DEM, and the trained Seine model.
